lines: The App Store takes the changelog of a release from CHANGELOG.md in the tarball, so every release is published without one; make changelog writes its sections into that file once it exists.
The App Store shows no changelog on the page of 3.0.0-dev.0.
For a version with a '-' it reads the Unreleased section, which is empty. The section of 3.0.0-dev.0 appears with the stable 3.0.0, below that release's own section.
